csv_project_name: Consultant for Larpenteur Avenue Corridor Study
csv_scope_of_work: Ramsey County (the "County"), through the Public Works Department, in cooperation with the Cities of Falcon Heights, Lauderdale, Maplewood, Roseville, and Saint Paul, seeks proposals from qualified Consultants or Contractors for the Larpenteur Avenue Corridor Study. This work will include agency coordination, public engagement, planning analysis, and engineering services to complete a corridor study and preliminary design (15% plans) for Larpenteur Avenue (CSAH 30) from the West County Line (west of MN Highway 280) to Parkway Drive (CSAH 27) and a short segment of Parkway Drive from Larpenteur Avenue to US Highway 61 (Arcade Street). Average annual daily traffic volumes along most of the corridor range from 12,000 to 15,000 vehicles per day, with higher volumes near State Highway 280 and lower volumes east of Interstate 35-E.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
